blindSpotsAndLimits: 15s fresh process pcpu samples can miss bursts and are not instantaneous per-frame utilization. Top10 retains only >=2% named entries; low-CPU or non-top10 index tasks can be absent from named records. Aggregate does not provide full per-process history.
CPU gates precede host preparation, not the exact benchmark-start command. Background activity can resume while app/profile/assets/shaders initialize or after a gate passes.
No per-process GPU occupancy, GPU/CPU clock, power draw or governor state measurement. OS thermal states are coarse proxies and are recorded rather than a per-arm thermal0 gate.
Disk/network I/O, memory pressure/swap/cache effects, scheduling/QoS and short contention are not isolated. Spotlight can affect I/O even when its CPU entry is not large.
HID idle is an indirect sampled observation, not a raw global event trace. Endpoint/gap criteria are conservative; timing boundary uncertainty stops rather than certifying cleanliness.

Current console-lock/saver/awake observations do not establish actual native present mode, physical display refresh or identical device power states. Hidden window/engine fullscreen and safe drawable are verified separately.

No intervention in Spotlight, service state or other applications; observations cannot isolate a causal indexing effect. n2 per variant/backend/batch remains limited even with better condition evidence.

perRunLoadReviewPlan.comparisonGrouping: Report forward and reverse independently first; include all valid prespecified8 arms per batch. Original8 possible-overlap arms are excluded from adoption and from the new averages.

measurement start/finish, fresh CPU sample count and CPU sample-age limits
fresh aggregate pcpu maximum/range, with game-inclusion caveat

other major non-owned top processes, workload identity when known
AC/LowPower/thermal states before/during/after and observed awake protection
perRunLoadReviewPlan.freshCPUSamples: Deduplicate by CPUSampledAtUnix; repeated2s rows contain cached15s CPU data. Count fresh sample timestamps inside the measured interval separately from carry-in samples. Retain raw sample times and window overlap/coverage.
perRunLoadReviewPlan.indexIdentification: Identify indexing-related names actually recorded, e.g. mds/mds_stores/mdworker/mdworker_shared/corespotlightd, preserving exact name/PID and avoiding claims that a name alone proves a specific indexing job or that absence from top10 proves indexing absent.
perRunLoadReviewPlan.interpretation: Compare per-run load annotations alongside the two repeated values for each app/backend and across forward/reverse batches. A CPU spike coinciding with low FPS is possible interference, not causal proof. Do not choose/drop arms after seeing FPS, repair a failed batch by automatic replay, or manufacture an adjusted FPS.
perRunLoadReviewPlan.joinKey: Use each receipt benchmarkStartUnixMS/benchmarkFinishUnixMS and plan ordinal/backend/variant. Do not treat entire app lifetime or preceding quiet wait as measured-frame CPU load.
perRunLoadReviewPlan.ownedVersusOther: Where existing owned-child/native PID events identify the game/lobby/host, separate those PIDs from candidate background processes. allProcessCPU is not background-only; a higher game CPU can be a result of changed throughput. If full ownership history is unavailable, flag the attribution limit rather than subtract by name alone.
